fonts.display: 'nhm', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'psl', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: All text, headlines, borders, link colors — the sole foreground color in the entire system. Near-black rather than pure black adds warmth that harmonizes with the cream canvas

palette.name: Bone Canvas
palette.role: Page background, card surfaces, nav bar — the warm off-white ground that makes the near-black ink read with high contrast (15.1:1 AAA) without feeling harsh or clinical

palette.name: Stone Veil
palette.role: Subtle surface variation against Bone Canvas — used sparingly for secondary panels or section backgrounds to create depth without introducing color
